name: SG/Send Vault Server
description: Zero-knowledge encrypted vault server + web UI. The server only ever stores ciphertext - keys never leave your browser or CLI.

SEND__STORAGE_MODE.description: Storage backend: 'memory' (ephemeral - data is lost on dyno restart, by design) or 's3' (durable - also set SEND__S3_BUCKET + AWS credentials). Heroku's filesystem is ephemeral, so 'disk' is not valid here.

SGRAPH_SEND__ACCESS_TOKEN.description: The deployment's access key (licensing key). Gates ALL routes including reads. Leave empty only if you explicitly want an open instance.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key (only for s3 mode).

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret key (only for s3 mode).

AWS_DEFAULT_REGION.description: AWS region of the bucket (only for s3 mode).
